name: AgentProof Demo Benchmark
description: Synthetic documentation QA cases for deterministic local evaluation; not an industry benchmark.

cases.question: What is the refund window?
cases.expected_answer: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.
cases.reference_context: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase when the receipt is provided.

cases.question: How do I reset my password?
cases.expected_answer: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the email instructions.
cases.reference_context: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page. A reset link will be emailed to the account address.

cases.question: When does support operate?
cases.expected_answer: Support is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM UTC.
cases.reference_context: Our support team works Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC, excluding holidays.

cases.question: Can I change my plan?
cases.expected_answer: You can change your plan from Billing in account settings.
cases.reference_context: Open Account Settings and select Billing to view and change your plan.

cases.question: Is there a mobile app?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, the service offers an iOS and Android mobile app.
cases.reference_context: Install our app for iOS or Android from the relevant app store.

cases.question: How do I export a report?
cases.expected_answer: Open Reports and choose Export CSV.
cases.reference_context: From the Reports page, select Export and then CSV.

cases.question: What payment methods are accepted?
cases.expected_answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and supported bank transfers.
cases.reference_context: Payment methods include Visa, Mastercard, and bank transfer in eligible regions.

cases.question: How can I contact support?
cases.expected_answer: Email support@example.test with your account ID and a description of the issue.
cases.reference_context: Contact support@example.test and include your account ID plus details of the issue.

cases.question: Can users share a workspace?
cases.expected_answer: Workspace members can collaborate when an administrator invites them.
cases.reference_context: Administrators can invite members to a workspace to collaborate on shared projects.

cases.question: How long are audit logs retained?
cases.expected_answer: Audit logs are retained for 90 days.
cases.reference_context: Audit log events remain available for 90 days before automatic deletion.

cases.question: What is the refund window?
cases.expected_answer: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase.
cases.reference_context: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase.

cases.question: Can I delete my account?
cases.expected_answer: Go to Account Settings, choose Privacy, and select Delete account.
cases.reference_context: Account Settings > Privacy contains the Delete account option.

cases.question: Where are files stored?
cases.expected_answer: Files are stored in encrypted cloud storage.
cases.reference_context: Uploaded files are stored in encrypted cloud storage with access controls.

cases.question: Does the service have an API?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, API access is available with an account API token.
cases.reference_context: Developers can create an API token in settings to access the REST API.

cases.question: What should I do if the service is unavailable?
cases.expected_answer: Check the status page and contact support if the incident continues.
cases.reference_context: Check the public status page for incidents. If the issue persists, contact support.
cases.actual_answer: Try turning your computer off and on. I cannot confirm the status-page procedure.

cases.question: Can you confirm the exact uptime yesterday?
cases.expected_answer: I do not have enough information to confirm yesterday's exact uptime.

cases.question: What is my private account password?
cases.expected_answer: I cannot access or disclose your password.
cases.reference_context: Password values are never visible to support staff.

cases.question: What is the maximum upload size?
cases.expected_answer: The maximum upload size is 10 MB.
cases.reference_context: Each file upload is limited to 10 MB.
